description: One-screen view of the QMS stack on qms-vps: services, API, server, DB/Redis, errors.

panels.description: 1 = running, 0 = no process. Source: Alloy process exporter.
panels.title: Services

panels.description: Time since the last successful nightly backup (02:30 WITA). Red after 26h. See Backup & Restore in the QMS docs.
panels.title: Last DB backup

panels.description: Tickets taken today (kiosk, public site and service-to-service).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:created" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Tickets created

panels.description: First calls today (recalls excluded).

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:called" [$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:recalled" [$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Called

panels.description: Tickets marked done today.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:resolved" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Resolved

panels.description: Created today minus called today ≈ people currently waiting.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:created" [$__range])) or vector(0)) - ((sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:called" [$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:recalled" [$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Still waiting

panels.description: Ticket called again (customer did not show up / moved counter).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:recalled" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Recalls

panels.description: Tickets moved to priority today.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Broadcast event" | json | eventName="ticket:prioritized" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Prioritized

panels.description: Created, resolved and recalled tickets per hour.
panels.title: Ticket activity per hour

panels.description: Average and 90th percentile wait, per 30 minutes. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: called" | json | unwrap waitSeconds | __error__="" [30m])
quantile_over_time(0.9, {job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: called" | json | unwrap waitSeconds | __error__="" [30m])

panels.title: Wait time (created → called)

panels.description: Created → called, today. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: called" | json | unwrap waitSeconds | __error__="" [$__range])

panels.title: Average wait

panels.description: 90th percentile wait today. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.9, {job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: called" | json | unwrap waitSeconds | __error__="" [$__range])

panels.title: 90% waited less than

panels.description: Called → resolved, today. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: resolved" | json | unwrap serviceSeconds | __error__="" [$__range])

panels.title: Average serving time

panels.description: Most people waiting (one service) when someone took a ticket. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: max_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: created" | json | unwrap waitingCount | __error__="" [$__range])

panels.title: Longest queue today

panels.description: Tickets created today per service. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: sum by (serviceName) (count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: created" | json [$__range]))

panels.title: Tickets by service

panels.description: Created → called, today, per service. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: called" | json | unwrap waitSeconds | __error__="" [$__range]) by (serviceName)

panels.title: Average wait by service

panels.description: Tickets resolved today per counter. Available once feat/ticket-event-metrics is deployed.

targets.expr: sum by (counterNumber) (count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} |= "Ticket event: resolved" | json [$__range]))

panels.title: Served per counter

panels.description: From the access log; route = Express route pattern.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} | json | context="HTTP" | label_format route=`{{ if .route }}{{ .route }}{{ else }}(unmatched){{ end }}` [1m]))

panels.title: Requests / min by route

panels.description: 95th percentile of durationMs over 5 minutes.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} | json | context="HTTP" | label_format route=`{{ if .route }}{{ .route }}{{ else }}(unmatched){{ end }}` | unwrap durationMs [5m]) by (route)

panels.title: p95 response time by route

panels.description: Per minute. 5xx = server errors (alerting above 5 in 5 min).

targets.expr: sum by (statusCode) (count_over_time({job="node_queue", service="node-queue-api"} | json | context="HTTP" | label_format route=`{{ if .route }}{{ .route }}{{ else }}(unmatched){{ end }}` [1m]))

panels.title: Responses by status code

panels.description: Resident memory per process group. The VPS has 2 GB.
panels.title: Memory per service

panels.description: 100% = one full CPU core (the VPS has 2).
panels.title: CPU per service

panels.title: Restarts (last 24h)

panels.description: App errors/warnings (winston) plus raw PM2 stderr. Phone numbers, emails and tokens are masked.

targets.expr: {job=~"node_queue|pm2", level=~"error|warn|"} !~ `AWS SDK for JavaScript|SDK releases are limited|a\.co/cUPnyil|node --trace-warnings` !~ `^\s*$` | json | line_format `{{ if .message }}[{{ .service }}] {{ .message }}{{ with .error_message }} — {{ . }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`
